summary: The DGA stepper: a horizontal or vertical trail of completed, current, upcoming and invalid steps for a multi-step form or a procedure list. Progress only by default; navigable steps emit stepSelect and the app decides whether to move.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.type: readonly DgaStep[] ({ label, description?, completed?, invalid?, disabled? })
inputs.description: The steps in order; label and description are translated.

inputs.name: active
inputs.description: Zero-based index of the current step, clamped to the steps; steps.length shows every step completed.

inputs.name: orientation
inputs.description: Horizontal progress bar or vertical trail with the bullets at the inline start.

inputs.name: linear
inputs.description: Earlier steps count as completed and only they (or completed steps) are selectable; false allows any enabled step and takes completion from each step's flag.

inputs.name: navigable
inputs.description: Renders each step as a button that emits stepSelect.

inputs.name: compact
inputs.description: Shows only the current step's label (mobile); a horizontal trail also compacts by itself in a container narrower than 36rem.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the step list (translated).

inputs.name: completedLabel
inputs.description: Screen-reader text read after a completed step's label (translated).

inputs.name: currentLabel
inputs.description: Screen-reader text read after the current step's label (translated).

inputs.name: invalidLabel
inputs.description: Screen-reader text read after an invalid step's label (translated).

outputs.name: stepSelect
outputs.description: Index of the step the user chose (navigable only; never the current or an unselectable step).

a11y: An ordered list named by label; the current step carries aria-current="step" and each state is also read as text (completedLabel, currentLabel, invalidLabel), never by colour alone; bullets are aria-hidden. Navigable: native buttons with a roving tabindex (Tab reaches the current step), arrow keys move along the trail (mirrored in RTL when horizontal, Up/Down when vertical), Home/End jump to the ends, unselectable steps are disabled and skipped, Enter/Space select. Compact mode hides labels visually only.
